data.name: Ivanya
data.gender_notes: Ivanya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ivanya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Iva', meaning 'Ishwara', the supreme god, and 'Nayani', meaning 'goddess of eyes or the moon'. In Hindu mythology, the moon goddess is associated with the nourishing, protective, and calming energies of the moon. The name Ivanya carries the meaning “Moon Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Ivanya usually hope their child will grow to embody moon goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
